title: Dunafon Castle – June 15th, 2013
author: madwire
excerpt: As one of my favorite venues in Co I am always happy to do an event there, especially one as beautiful as the Oanh and Sam Maxfield wedding. The backdrop is superb despite a little rain the event was as beautiful as the rest of the venue. DJ Bryan
